name: Oubliette
tagline: Fight down a four-card corridor; only the loot in your lair counts.
core_loop: On your turn slay a corridor monster with one hand card and a die roll, loot unguarded gold, bank a card into your lair for points, rest to draw, or scout to reorder the corridor.
win_condition: Highest lair score (trophies, banked gold, pair bonuses, minus scars) when the dungeon deck runs dry and the final round ends.
